policy: Reference-only registry. Built-in Skills are project-specific workflows, not wholesale vendored upstream code. No third-party scripts installed or executed. Partial document review is not a repository security/license audit or a global best-Skill benchmark.

references.adopted: Independent evidence-first review, confidentiality and explicit human responsibility.
references.boundary: Only stated SKILL.md excerpt reviewed; not all references, scripts or dependencies. No license grant inferred.

references.adopted: Evidence-bound drafting, no invented citations, separate writing and final approval.
references.boundary: Local contracts replace host-specific or unavailable tooling assumptions.

references.adopted: Examine methods, bias, inference and applicability; domain-specific frameworks only where justified.
references.boundary: A checklist does not automatically validate science.

references.adopted: Truthful encoding, preserved data transformations and actual output inspection.
references.boundary: No universal required plotting library or image generator.

references.adopted: Traceable search planning and synthesis, subject to local Source Policy.
references.not_adopted: Mandatory AI-generated figures, arbitrary minimum database counts, or forced paid tools.

references.adopted: Record design, assumptions, effect estimates, uncertainty and reproducibility.
references.not_adopted: Claims that p-values prove an effect; mechanical one-size-fits-all test selection.

references.adopted: Task triggers, explicit input/output contracts and iterative behavioral evaluation.
references.boundary: No external code copied; full licensing and dependency review would be required before any future vendoring.

template.license: Original rights retained; excluded from the project's MIT grant. Binary PPT not distributed.
